description: This file provides Czech localization strings for the Select2 4.0.6-rc.1 library, defining translated messages for UI elements such as error messages, input length validations, and search prompts.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that results could not be loaded.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message prompting the user to input fewer characters, with correct pluralization based on the input length.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message prompting the user to input additional characters, with correct pluralization.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that additional results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the maximum number of selections allowed.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that no search results were found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a search is in progress.
